question: Which foreign manufacturing establishments supplying drugs currently in shortage have not been inspected since FY2021?
tier_reasons: part of the question cannot be answered from this data (disclosed)
all evidence from certified tools; interpretations disclosed; verifier passed
headline: As of 2025-10-23, 4 foreign sites tied to Current shortages have no inspection after FY2021, and 2 more sites were never inspected and have unknown country.
markdown:
## Answer

As of 2025-10-23, 4 foreign manufacturing sites linked to drugs with Current shortage status had their last inspection in FY2021 or earlier. [E1] This is a partial list. Only 13 of 57 Current shortage records could be linked to a manufacturing site. [E1]

## Detail

Foreign sites with last inspection in FY2021 or earlier:

- FEI 3025111222, Aurobindo Pharma Unit IV, Visakhapatnam, India. Last inspection ended 2018-04-03 (FY2018), classification VAI. Drug in shortage: Vancomycin HCl. Source row inspections#L17. [E1]
- FEI 3026333444, Zhejiang Tianyu Pharmaceutical, Taizhou, China. Last inspection ended 2020-03-20 (FY2020), classification NAI. Drug in shortage: Piperacillin-Tazobactam. Source row inspections#L18. [E1]
- FEI 3027555666, Macleods Pharmaceuticals Ltd, Mumbai, India. Last inspection ended 2017-04-11 (FY2017), classification NAI. Drug in shortage: Ceftriaxone Sodium. Source row inspections#L19. [E1]
- FEI 4005777888, Shanxi Zhendong Taisheng Pharma, Changzhi, China. Last inspection ended 2019-07-22 (FY2019), classification NAI. Drug in shortage: Ampicillin-Sulbactam. Source row inspections#L20. [E1]

Country unknown, never inspected (not labelled foreign):

- FEI 3007891234, sponsor Zhejiang Huahai Pharmaceutical. Drug in shortage: Meropenem. Country is UNKNOWN. [E1]
- FEI 4001567890, sponsor Hainan Poly Pharm Co Ltd. Drug in shortage: Cefepime HCl. Country is UNKNOWN. [E1]

Excluded because inspected more recently: FEI 3010234567, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, India, last inspection ended 2023-11-07 (FY2024), linked to Amoxicillin-Clavulanate. [E1]

## Interpretation applied

- **Not inspected since FY2021:** The reading used is last inspection in FY2021 or earlier. The alternate is last inspection strictly before FY2021. Both readings return the same 4 foreign sites and the same 2 never-inspected sites. [E1, E2]
- **Foreign:** The reading used is an inspection-record country other than United States. Sites with no inspection record are reported as UNKNOWN country and not counted as foreign. Inferring from sponsor name was not used. [E1]
- **Currently in shortage:** Current status only, using the latest revision of each shortage record, as of 2025-10-23. [E1]
- **Manufacturing establishment:** The facility identified by FEI on the application, not the sponsor. Both the inspected firm name and sponsor name are shown. [E1]

## Caveats

- Coverage is partial. 44 of 57 Current shortage records reference an application that is not in the data, so their manufacturing sites cannot be identified. This list is not a full list of foreign sites supplying drugs in shortage. [E1]
- Two sites have no inspection record, so their country and inspection history are unknown. The sponsor names may suggest foreign firms, but that is inference, not data. [E1]
- FEI 4005777888 and FEI 4001567890 have an FEI prefix anomaly. Verify them against FDA's FEI portal before citing. [E1]
- Many Current shortage records have not been revised in a long time. Status is reported as recorded and should be confirmed before quoting. [E1]
- One Amoxicillin shortage has an earlier Resolved record and a later Current record. The later Current record is used. [E1]
- The Amoxicillin-Clavulanate shortage records link to an application whose active ingredient is Amoxicillin, which is a possible mislink. The site tied to it, FEI 3010234567, is already excluded as inspected more recently. [E1]

## Cannot be answered from this data

- The foreign status of FEI 3007891234 and FEI 4001567890. [E1]
- Whether these sites cause the shortages, or are the sole suppliers of the affected drugs. [E1]
- Sites behind the 44 Current shortage records that do not link to an application. [E1]

gate.reason: The question can be answered via the join Shortage(current) → Application (via related_application, only 21 of 150 rows resolve; 13 of 57 Current resolve) → Facility (manufacturing_fei) → Inspection. Foreign is defined by country from inspections; uninspected FEIs have UNKNOWN country. "Not inspected since FY2021" needs a fiscal-year window and a no-inspection-after rule. Coverage limits must be disclosed: only 13 of 57 Current shortage rows link to an application, so results cover only that subset. The AND-linked "Amoxicillin-Clavulanate" defect (ingredient mismatch) should be excluded or flagged if it appears in results. Answerable with stated coverage caveats and interpretation choices.
